documents.text: Harry Harvey Sr. Harry William Harvey Sr. (January 10, 1901 – November 27, 1985) was an American actor of theatre, film, and television. He was the father of actor, script supervisor, and director Harry William Harvey Jr.. Born in Indian Territory, now Oklahoma, Harvey appeared in minstrel shows, in vaudeville, and on the Broadway stage but is best remembered as a character actor who appeared in more than three hundred films and episodes of television series. He co-starred in "The Oregon Trail" (1936), with John Wayne, "Old Overland Trail" (1953), "Wyoming Renegades" (1954), "Ride Beyond Vengeance" (1966) with Chuck Connors,
